import re
import sys

text = sys.stdin.read()
values = {}

pattern = re.compile(
    r"\b(a|b|c|d|e|f|g|h|TMP)\s*<-\s*"
    r"(?:\(\s*(a|b|c|d|e|f|g|h|TMP)\s*\+\s*(\d+)\s*\)"
    r"\s*mod\s*(\d+)|(\d+))\b"
)

for match in pattern.finditer(text):
    target, source, increment, modulus, constant = match.groups()
    if constant is not None:
        values[target] = int(constant)
    else:
        values[target] = (values[source] + int(increment)) % int(modulus)

order = ("a", "b", "c", "d", "e", "f", "g", "h", "TMP")
print("".join(f"{name} ?= {values[name]}; " for name in order).rstrip())
